name: AI for PMOs and Portfolio Management
description: One company, one planning year, six real PMO problems: catching watermelon projects before they turn red, cutting a portfolio to budget with a solver instead of a chatbot, staffing 64 roles under California's ADMT rules, forecasting a defense program without leaking CUI, governing PPM agents, and reporting what PMO AI is really worth. Every module ends in a Decision Lab where the fast option has a delayed cost.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for PMOs and Portfolio Management

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 18 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 45 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Evaluate a portfolio early-warning system on held-out labeled history (flag precision, recall and lead time with their uncertainty, RAID themes and extracted dependencies) and accept an AI-drafted summary only when every claim has a checked evidence link

alignment.targetName: Analyze AI-assisted demand intake for field accuracy, agreement with the governance panel measured against the panel's own agreement, and length bias, and decide what the panel must still score itself
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Select a portfolio with a mixed-integer optimizer under budget, skill, mandatory, dependency and exclusion constraints, use an LLM only to explain results and run what-ifs through the solver, and present scenarios with a faithful decision log
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Evaluate a skill forecast and an assignment-shortlist process for stale data and disparity, and design the risk assessment, real human review, pre-use notice and disparity check California's ADMT regulations require for allocation of work
alignment.targetFramework: Wirewalk Institute of AI course outcomes

alignment.targetName: Analyze a defense program's schedule health, Monte Carlo forecast and earned-value position, audit AI-drafted variance narratives for invented causes, and choose where AI may process CUI

alignment.targetName: Evaluate PPM platforms and agents on data fit, license prerequisites, permissions, audit logging, cost and exit, gate agent releases with a prompt-injection test pack, and tier the company's AI uses in an owned inventory

alignment.targetName: Evaluate AI-touched financial numbers: a capitalization control under ASC 350-40 and ASU 2025-06, benefits variance without causal claims, and PMO AI value split into booked, capacity and risk in year-one and steady-state views

alignment.targetName: Create a PMO AI operating plan that sequences use cases by value, data readiness and legal exposure, with evaluation thresholds fixed before testing, controls, owners, monitoring, a tested rollback and an honest value statement
